brief:
A child was killed by Israeli gunfire in al-Mawasi, a coastal area in Rafah in southern Gaza, Al Jazeera Arabic reported on Monday, citing ambulance and emergency sources. The incident marks the latest reported death in the territory amid ongoing military operations.

Details of the circumstances surrounding the shooting remained unclear. Emergency responders confirmed the child's death in the densely populated enclave.
dek: Israeli gunfire kills child in Gaza A child has been killed by Israeli gunfire in Rafah’s al-Mawasi, in the southern Gaza Strip, Al Jazeera Arabic reported, citing ambulance and emergency sources.
title: Israeli gunfire kills child in Rafah
